title: A Veil for the Choir Revisited
author: Mara Eastwick
blurb: Sebastian Hartwell, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
